items.title: Margin revival, Semaglutide launch to drive Dr Reddy’s growth momentum in FY27
items.description: Dr Reddy's Laboratories anticipates a gradual recovery this fiscal year. The company faced a profit drop last year due to US business pressures. However, operations in India, Europe, and emerging markets show healthy growth. New launches like Semaglutide and Abatacept are expected to drive future expansion. Margins are set to improve with better product mix and cost controls.

items.title: Honda books first annual loss, hit by $9 billion EV charge
items.description: Honda Motor reported its first annual loss in almost 70 years, totaling 414.3 billion yen, due to U.S. tariffs and significant restructuring costs for its electric vehicle business. The automaker incurred over $9 billion in EV-related losses and anticipates further expenses, though it expects to return to profitability this fiscal year.

items.title: HAL Q4 Results: Net profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 4,196 crore; revenue up 2%
items.description: HAL Q4 Results: The defence major’s revenue from operations rose 2% YoY to Rs 13,942 crore in Q4FY26, from Rs 13,700 crore reported in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: IRFC Q4 Results: Co posts muted profit growth at Rs 1,684 crore, revenue rises 9% YoY
items.description: Indian Railway Finance Corporation reported a largely flat Q4FY26 performance, with net profit inching up to Rs 1,684 crore from Rs 1,682 crore a year earlier. Revenue, however, rose 9% year-on-year to Rs 7,336 crore, reflecting steady growth in business operations.

items.title: Air India posts annual loss of $2.8 billion, Singapore Air results show
items.description: Air India's losses amounted to 3.56 ‌billion Singapore dollars, the ​annual ​report ⁠showed, which at current exchange rates ​was $2.8 billion.

items.title: Hudco Q4 Results: Profit shoots up 172% to Rs 1,981 crore; co declares Rs 1.5 dividend
items.description: Hudco posted a 172% rise in Q4 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,981 crore, driven by higher interest income and a substantial deferred tax gain. Revenue from operations climbed 25%, while annual profit rose 49%. The board also recommended a final dividend of Rs 1.5 per share for FY26.

items.title: Tata Motors PV Q4 Results: Profit falls 32% YoY to Rs 5,783 cr; co declares Rs 3/share dividend
items.description: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles saw its net profit drop 32% year-on-year to Rs 5,783 crore. Revenue from operations grew 7% to Rs 1.05 lakh crore. The company recommended a final dividend of Rs 3 per share. JLR faced a challenging year with revenue and profit impacted by several factors.

items.title: JSW Steel Q4 Results: Cons profit surges 131% YoY to Rs 3,475 crore, revenue rises 14%
items.description: JSW Steel reported a significant 11-fold surge in consolidated net profit for the March quarter, reaching Rs 16,370 crore. This impressive growth was accompanied by a 14% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations, which stood at Rs 51,180 crore for Q4FY26.

items.title: Shadowfax Q4 Results: Co reports Rs 56 crore profit, revenue up 74%
items.description: Revenue for the quarter under review grew nearly 73.73 per cent year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 1,237 crore from Rs 712 crore a year ago, Shadowfax said in a regulatory filing.

items.title: United Spirits Q4 Results: Profit jumps 27% on demand for premium liquor
items.description: Karnataka, one of India's highest-tax ​alcohol markets, said ​in March it ⁠will scrap government price controls and shift to strength-based excise taxation from April 2026, allowing companies to set prices while ​cutting tax slabs.
